title: Starbright | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Starbright is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Charming 3‑Bedroom Beach Cottage in Seacrest Beach — Steps from Sand, Pool & Local FlavorWelcome to your 30A getaway in Seacrest Beach, nestled in the relaxed coastal community of The Cottages at Camp Creek. This bright and inviting 3‑bedroom, 2‑bath cottage sleeps up to 8 guests, making it perfect for families, friends, or groups who want to enjoy Florida’s sugar‑white beaches, scenic bike paths, and vibrant local culture. Everything is just a short walk from your front door.Your SpaceThe living area is bright and inviting, with hardwood floors and coastal-inspired decor that create a warm atmosphere, perfect for relaxing after a day on the beach. The fully equipped kitchen makes preparing meals easy with a coffee maker, Keurig, toaster, microwave, and oven. You can enjoy meals at the family-sized dining table with six chairs plus bar seating for four, or step out to the large covered patio with plenty of casual seating for morning coffee, evening meals, or simply relaxing outdoors. A washer and dryer are also included for added convenience on longer stays.Sleeping ArrangementsMaster Bedroom: 1 King bed, TV, direct access to the back porch through French doors, private bathroomGuest Bedroom: 1 Queen bed, TV, shared bathroomBunk Room: Two sets of Twin-over-Twin beds, TV, DVDCommunity and Outdoor AmenitiesAs part of The Cottages at Camp Creek, you will enjoy the 86 foot community pool, perfect for cooling off and socializing, a soothing hot tub to relax after an active day, and private deeded beach access just minutes from the Gulf’s white sands.Local Attractions & ExperiencesThe cottage is perfectly positioned to explore the best of 30A:* Seacrest Town Center and Watersound Towncenter for Publix, Ambrosia, Village Market, Nigels, and Sweet Henriettas.* Dining favorites like Amigos, Amicis, Idyll Proper, and Attycat's Arcade along 30Avenue.* Unique shopping and entertainment at Shades, George’s Alys Beach, Peddlers Pavilion, and Rosemary Downtown (including The Pearl and Sugar Shack).* Bike or stroll along scenic 30A pathways to experience coastal charm, boutique shops, and local eateries, all within reach from your cottage.Activities and Adventures with XplorieYour stay includes one ticket per day, per activity with Xplorie, valued at over $800 per night. Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise, enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, try Black Light Mini Golf, and take scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure.Other Things to Note:* Snowbird Friendly!* Parking for 2 cars* Pet Friendly: This property is pet friendly! If bringing a dog, please contact Reservations as an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
